payload.title: kino and nico are optional installs
payload.body: Operator ruling: kino and nico stay in the corpus package and become optional installs, offered but not preselected, rather than moving to separate plugins. A stranger's default install gets the general positions (mav, architect, planner, implementer, assayer); nico is offered with the corpus-authoring practice, kino as an example of a domain-specialized architect. A separate plugin package stays available later if kino's domain vocabulary grows beyond what a general corpus should carry.
